marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Tuesday.
marine.text:
Wind northwest 20 knots diminishing to northwest 15 early this
evening then increasing to northwest 25 late overnight. Wind increasing to
northwest 35 Tuesday afternoon. Scattered flurries ending near noon Tuesday. Flurries
Tuesday evening. Fog patches dissipating near midnight. Visibility 1 mile or
less in fog patches and in flurries. Temperatures near minus 1. <br/>
